BOOKS & WRITING

Michel Claeys: Books in Chinese

Six published works, covering Essence Therapy, dreamwork, emotional intelligence education and parenting.

MEET THE AUTHOR

Michel Claeys Bouuaert

Belgian psychotherapist and founder of Essence Therapy, he has been engaged in emotional intelligence and social-emotional education for a long time. His publications cover Essence Therapy Methods, dreamwork and Practice for Families and Educators.

Getting to know Michel Claeys and his experience ↗

PUBLISHED IN CHINESE

Books Published in Chinese

From Essence Therapy, dreamwork to emotional intelligence education and parenting, read Michel Claeys along different themes.

01 / emotional intelligence educationWith group leadership

The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook

How was Gaoemotional intelligencetrained?

Classroom teaching and game activities are used as a carrier to discuss emotions, needs, communication and choices, and also focus on how leaders can establish a supportive learning environment in the group.

2018 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

02 / Growing up together in parenting

Parent Yourself Before Raising Children

Parental Growth Support Handbook

Treat parenting as a continuous learning process for parents, start from self-awareness, and discuss how to build a supportive relationship in the family.

2021 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

03 / Inner space and self-knowledge

Embracing the Inner Parent and Child

Transpersonal Psychological Strategies for Growth and Healing

Starting from basic concepts such as personality, self and Essence, it gradually introduces the work of growth from the perspective of the inner child, inner parent and transpersonal.

2013 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

04 / Essence TherapyMethod

Counseling from the Heart

The transpersonal paradigm in psychotherapy

Systematic discussion of the consulting perspective, seven principles and specific work process of Essence Therapy is an important work for understanding this method.

2019 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

05 / dreamworkAnd Inner Exploration

The Truth of Dreams

The theory and practice of dream interpretation

Using the recording, understanding and translation of dreams as clues, Michel Claeys introduces how to bring dreams into personal exploration, group study and consultation work.

2021 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

06 / For childrenemotional intelligence education

Emotional Intelligence Education for Children

A teaching guide for children’s social-emotional learning

Focusing on children's emotional and social abilities, we introduce teaching activities and leadership ideas that can be used in classrooms and groups.

2022 · World Publishing CorporationRead details ↗

A READING JOURNEY

From Early Works to Six Books Today

The same work has been published under different titles or new editions. Reading along the publication date, you can also see the continuous development work of Michel Claeys.

2000s

emotional intelligenceClassroom and Early Writings

Michel Claeys The emotional intelligenceclassroom work written in China was published earlier as "A Lesson That Should Be Made Up for". It was later continuously revised and developed into the The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook (《情商教练手册》) we read today.

Read The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook (《情商教练手册》) ↗
2010

The Truth of Dreams

The Truth of Dreams (《梦的真相》)Early Chinese version published. The book uses the dreamer's personal experience as a starting point to discuss recording dreams, understanding dreams, and carrying out inner work.

Enter dreamwork ↗
2013

Inner Space and Childrenemotional intelligence education

Embracing the Inner Parent and Child (《内在父母与内在小孩的拥抱》) and Emotional Intelligence Education for Children (《儿童情商教育》) start from personal growth and children’s education respectively, broadening the reading entrance of these methods.

Read Embracing the Inner Parent and Child (《内在父母与内在小孩的拥抱》) ↗
2018—2019

emotional intelligenceTeaching and Essence Therapy

The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook (《情商教练手册》) was published in 2018; the 2019 edition Counseling from the Heart (《由心咨询》) systematically discusses the consultative relationship, principles and working processes of Essence Therapy.

Read Counseling from the Heart (《由心咨询》) ↗
2021—2022

For families and new generations of readers

Parent Yourself Before Raising Children (《育儿先育己》), new version The Truth of Dreams (《梦的真相》) and new version Emotional Intelligence Education for Children (《儿童情商教育》) are published one after another, respectively responding to parenting, dreamwork and children’s social and emotional learning.

Read Parent Yourself Before Raising Children (《育儿先育己》) ↗
